item.title: Kenya Power Increases Dividends After Posting Ksh 14.8B Profit in Six Months
item.description: For the six months ending December 31, 2025, Kenya Power reported a profit before taxes of Ksh14.83 billion, up Ksh769 million from Ksh14.06 billion in the corresponding previous period.

item.title: Govt Restricts & Revokes Licences of Several SACCOs
item.description: According to the government, the move is aimed at protecting members of the public from fraud and unregulated financial activities amid a rise in cases of misappropriations.

item.title: Kenya Met Reveals Days to Receive High Temperatures This Week
